_doc: Dashboard starting states: real days from 2020-2021 (held out from training). 'last_input_day' is the 3rd input day.

scenarios.label: Active monsoon, mid-July 2021
scenarios.description: Peak monsoon: a good default for shock experiments.

scenarios.label: Monsoon onset, early June 2020
scenarios.description: Around the monsoon's arrival over Kerala.

scenarios.label: Heavy rain, late July 2021
scenarios.description: Very wet spell over the west coast and central India.

scenarios.label: Pre-monsoon heat, late May 2020
scenarios.description: Hot, dry north-west India: watch the rain checks on dry days.

scenarios.label: Bay of Bengal cyclone, May 2020
scenarios.description: Cyclone Amphan forming over the Bay of Bengal.

scenarios.label: Arabian Sea cyclone, May 2021
scenarios.description: Cyclone Tauktae moving up the west coast.

scenarios.label: Winter, January 2021
scenarios.description: Cool, mostly dry season over the plains.
